description: Price a stablecoin swap against one position, on-chain, at the current block — no custody, nothing signed, nothing moved. Use this to check USDC/USDT liquidity and get the output amount before preparing a swap. Note that a maker may gate a position on the caller holding an access licence token, and roughly four in five do — those answer with a clear reason instead of a price, which is a property of the maker's strategy rather than an error.

amount.description: Input amount in token base units, as an integer string. e.g. "1000000" for 1 USDC.

name: trdefi_quote
